title: Starch-assisted facile gel formation method for the synthesis of Fe–Mn binary oxide for the simultaneous removal of As(III) and As(V)
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38183-38192
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06319H, Paper
